StaffRole.title: StaffRole
StaffRole.description: Authorized admin or co-admin account permitted to access the private Leads & Quotations portal.

email.description: Lowercase Google account email address of the admin or co-admin.

role.description: Access level granted to the user.

addedBy.description: Email of the admin who granted this role.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the role was created.

ClientEnquiry.title: ClientEnquiry
ClientEnquiry.description: Client service enquiry captured from the public quote form, Gmail, WhatsApp, Excel, or Google Sheets.

name.description: Client full name or company name.

gmailMessageId.description: Optional Gmail message identifier for deduplication.

quotation.description: Optional quotation details prepared by admin or co-admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when enquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when enquiry was last updated.

SheetsConfig.title: SheetsConfig
SheetsConfig.description: Shared Google Sheets sync configuration for admin and co-admin.

updatedBy.description: Email of the staff member who updated the sheet link.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/staffRoles/{emailId}.description: Stores authorized Co-Admin and Admin accounts keyed by lowercase email.

/enquiries/{enquiryId}.description: Stores client enquiries and quotations. Public users may only create Website enquiries; only Admin and Co-Admin can read, update, or delete.

/appConfig/{configId}.description: Stores shared workspace configuration such as connected Google Sheet ID for Admin and Co-Admin.
